source.source_composition: Same frozen 276-input object as v2, two snapshotted source overlays add the observed Silent A10 Test Subject phase-power transition. Source/live ancestry recorded separately after actual publication.
source.repair_scope: Single Test Subject, actual Silent A10, observed111/Enrage3/Adaptable1 ->212/PainfulStabs1 ->313 power sets; whole-fight only. F48/F49 signatures have direct frozen evidence. Other roles/ascensions/unknown signatures/short rollout unchanged. No new Wound-pile settlement rule.
source.reuse: 1114 raw prediction rows outside31 exact input-predicate keys reused from completed v2; four new tuning rows and58 new validation rows. Compiled numeric isolation and actual adapter probes saved. Never old7e1193 as this baseline.
source.leak_method: Original turns data and original assay retained; 17 diagnostic endpoint-timing discrepancies recorded separately, no relabeling to pass gates.

numerical_reuse.reason: Exact pure-function text relocated into its existing live adapter; call site, arithmetic, move data, RNG and full 200-sample seed schedule unchanged. Nine observed-intent outputs and all eight isolation groups plus actual B2/B3 construction exactly equal. This is not a partial-budget timing equivalence claim.

source.old_fixed_comparison: Old 7e1193 calibration is a different source/data object. Metric changes cannot be attributed solely to the A2 Paper Krane repair.
source.production_applicability: Frozen full 200-sample object only; no equivalence or calibration claim for current H1 finite-prefix production, refreshed knowledge, later repairs, natural play or F48-to-F49 joint probability.
